newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end up on institutional support.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end up on institutional support.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended up on Friday on institutional support buying in shares with a heavy index weighting, but volume fell to a year-low with most investors sidelined waiting for a clearer direction, brokers said.
The B index rose 0.527 points or 0.61 percent to 86.867 points on very thin volume of 8.608 million shares worth $6.102 million.

Investors were taking a wait-and-see attitude for fear of new announcements of crackdown measures, brokers said. The issue of 230 million new B shares of Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle Co Ltd also attracted the attention of many investors.
Jinan Qingqi is issuing its B shares on Thursday and Friday at a price of $0.482 per share.
Brokers said that major investors had shifted most of their capital into buying the new B shares, resulting in today's extremely low volume.

"Market sentiment seems stable on institutional support for big firms, and the A share rebound late in the session also triggered some retail investors' buying, which pushed the index up," one broker said.
"If there is no major negative news during the weekend, the market will start a new run up early next week with investors returning to the secondary market," another broker said.
Of 43 B shares, 31 traded, with 14 up, seven flat and 10 down.

Shanghai Tyre and Rubber Co was the biggest gainer on institutional speculative buying, and was responsible for most of index's rise, surging $0.058 or 10.00 percent to $0.638 on volume of 13,000 shares.

Pudong real estate Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development was the most actively traded with some institutions changing hands, up $0.004 or 0.56 percent to $0.718 on volume of 1.6 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index ended up on institutional buying in selective stocks late in the session, but trading was sluggish on market uncertainties, brokers said.
The index rose 23.217 points or 1.76 percent to 1,341.862 points on volume of 327.7 million shares worth 5.4 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index moved up 40.005 points or 1.02 percent to 3,953.159 points.
Xiamen Motor Co was the star on institutional buying, soaring 0.78 or 10.06 percent to 8.53 yuan on volume of 2.7 million shares.
